summary: Completed backend + frontend retest for Phase1 shape tools, protected-template enforcement, and iteration19 admin customer-editable toggle regression. Targeted backend pytest passed (7/7). Customer and admin UI flows passed for core requested checks.

ui_bugs.issue: When moving a selected shape outside bounds via numeric position, error text references max font size (text-specific wording), which is misleading for shapes.

action_items: Optional UX copy fix: make boundary-error text shape-aware instead of mentioning max font size.
Run one additional full e2e for save/reopen/download(800px)/cart/checkout pixel-equivalence at 100% vs 250%+pan, which was not fully re-executed in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS: Backend shape validation enforces six-shape enum, line h==stroke behavior, proportional constraints, and outline minimum interior checks.
PASS: Circular envelope logic is applied for circle shape bounds (disk-based, not square-corner based) in both backend and frontend geometry checks.
PASS: Protected template server enforcement still rejects forged mutations of fixed text while allowing customer-field edits.
PASS: Iteration19 HIGH bug appears resolved — customer-editable checkbox can be toggled while text preview pending and remains stable after render.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core requested shape/admin regression checks passed; some full-flow regressions not re-run end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: Created UI admin template fixture TEST_UI_I20_TOGGLE (published). Backend tests also created temporary test product/template fixtures via pytest helpers and cleanup tracker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated: shape picker(6), add/resize/mode/layer cap, line length-stroke independence, circle roundness, rectangle lock behavior, boundary rejection messaging, responsive breakpoints 320/390/768/1024/1440 + short landscape, admin back-nav ?tab=templates, protected template one customer-field behavior in preview, and pending-toggle regression. Not fully revalidated this run: customer full checkout snapshot chain + 100 vs 250 pan pixel identity + archived historical replay checks.
rca of the issue: Iteration19 remaining bug RCA recheck: prior failure came from checkbox being non-deterministically blocked during text-preview pending. Current implementation disables TemplateFieldSettings only on busy (not text-pending) and text updates patch only text/effect/geometry keys. Reproduction in this run showed pending=true and checkbox successfully persisted unchecked after render, indicating fix is effective.
